subject: Chargeback allocation & EU withholding — request for credit split
messages:
From: Anna Petrova <anna.p@ledgercorp.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ledgercorp-billing@ledgercorp.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:14:00 +0100
Subject: Unexpected chargeback & withholding allocation for July invoice

Hi Rafael,

Quick heads up — our accounting team identified a chargeback on INV-202607-LEDGER-01 that appears to have been processed without applying the reserved capacity discount we agreed in the July PO (PO #LC-07-2026). The net result is an overcollection of €12,500 on that invoice. Separately, our local AP has applied a 10% EU withholding at source on the payment; they need documentation from Redwood to reconcile withheld tax against our VAT filing.

Requested next steps from our side:
- Can you confirm how Redwood will handle the overcollection (credit memo vs immediate refund)?
- We need a split: €9,000 credited back to INV-202607-LEDGER-01 and €3,500 either as an account-level goodwill credit or refunded to our bank — please advise the cleanest path from Redwood's perspective.
- Provide formal withholding documentation (certificate or statement) so our team can offset the 10% withholding against Redwood receipts.

I've attached the invoice and our payment evidence for reference (INV-202607-LEDGER-01.pdf, payment-evidence-202607.pdf). Please let me know the expected timing for the credit/credit memo and any evidence you can supply for the withholding.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Petrova
Head of Finance Operations
LedgerCorp

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Anna Petrova <anna.p@ledgercorp.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected chargeback & withholding allocation for July invoice

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. We’ll handle this as a split-credit workflow to keep bookkeeping clean. High-level plan: 

1) Temporary goodwill credit: We will post a provisional goodwill line of €3,500 to hold for the customer while we reconcile.
2) Credit memo for invoice: We will issue a formal credit memo for €9,000 against INV-202607-LEDGER-01 so your AR system can consume it.
3) Withholding documentation: We’ll provide a brief statement confirming refund/credit values and a tax-recon note for your AP that references Redwood’s payee details. If LedgerCorp needs a Withholding Tax Certificate from Redwood to file locally, please confirm the legal entity (Redwood Inference Ltd. / Redwood Inference Inc.) and the country — I’ve asked Naomi to confirm tax handling.

Actions I’m taking right now:
- CC-ing Naomi (tax/finance) and Marissa (billing) to prepare the credit memo and advise on withholding documentation.
- I’m proposing we issue a credit memo for €9,000 and apply a goodwill credit of €3,500 to the account (non-refundable) unless you prefer an immediate refund for that portion — please confirm by EOD tomorrow.

We’ll track this under deal LC-2026-07-EXT-9921 and I’ll push to get a CM reference back to you within 48 hours once finance confirms.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales — EMEA
Redwood Inference

Timing: Customer asked for a CM reference within 48 hours — can we execute by EOD today? If not, provide the earliest ETA.
